segments.motivation: To organize and track projects, tasks, and team progress effectively.
To manage personal and business tasks, organize workflows, and collaborate with small teams or clients.
To facilitate team collaboration, assign responsibilities, and maintain visibility across shared projects and tasks.

tasks.purpose: to stay on top of responsibilities
to team members for collaborative projects
with reminders to ensure deadlines are met
to streamline processes and save time

benefits.claim: It significantly improves organization and clarity for both personal and team tasks.
The platform is user-friendly with an intuitive visual interface that makes it easy to adopt.
It fosters effective team collaboration by providing a shareable format for progress and tasks.

frictions.claim: Boards can become crowded and overwhelming when managing very large or complex projects with many team members.
It may lack advanced features for time management, detailed data manipulation, or statistical analysis.
Some desired customization options or advanced functionalities might be locked behind paid plans.
